article.title: Inside a Chicago home, a photographer documents the life her family built
article.summary: For eight years, photographer Jennifer Teresa Villanueva has documented her Mexican American family's everyday life in Chicago, capturing intimate moments of love, labor and sacrifice. (Image credit: Jennifer Teresa Villanueva)
